1. Reasoning-oriented post-training focuses mainly on mathematical reasoning; limited-data setting can suffer repetitive tokens/repeated reasoning segments, interrupting reasoning (E267).

11. H1L1–H1L3 near-zero scores characterize early readout from H2L3-trained model, not capabilities of models independently trained with a single model cycle (E127) — a scope caveat.
